title: Guard condition in row form
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $p$ be a tuple of an input-head position and work-head positions, let $q$ be a case consisting of an optional state, an optional input symbol, and one optional symbol per work tape, let $b$ be a codec bit, and let $r,t$ be codec rows. The wired port assignment satisfies the codec guard if and only if the state and input-head position in $r$ equal those in $q$ and $p$, respectively; each work-tape head in $r$ equals its position in $p$; the encoded input symbol read at $p$ equals the input symbol in $q$; and, for every work tape, the symbol recorded in $r$ at its position in $p$ equals the corresponding symbol in $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
